title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive

meta.Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, you guys gotta hear this! Guess what?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We got a new offer for work!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you get to do this time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get to appear on a mini-segment for this online show, where we'll apparently showcase trending artists.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, this is incredible!
And just the other day, you were all asked to appear on that local radio program out in the country.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shizuku's commercial must be the reason why the offers are slowly starting to roll back in, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The person who got in touch with us said her commercial was the reason, so it's definitely been having a big impact.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You brought us back from the brink, Shizuku. That makes you our savior!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Savior might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... I'm so glad that my commercial has led to us receiving offers for work once again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I plan on continuing to do everything I can to make sure we get to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
There were moments when I genuinely believed that we'd stop receiving offers for good...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They are slowly starting to trickle back in.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, umm...
I'm still a bit puzzled...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Puzzled?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I am happy that we've started receiving offers again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the reason why we stopped receiving offers after Idol Lovers still remains a mystery.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
To be fair, in show business, it's rare for anyone to get steady work. We might've just had a lucky streak up until that point.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's no doubting that we absolutely floored everyone at Idol Lovers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Exactly. That's why I'm still wondering...
Why did we suddenly stop receiving offers after that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we have started receiving offers again, but it's still a lot less compared to before we performed at Idol Lovers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I think we should keep investigating the root cause a little more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I should be being more positive since we just got a new offer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also believe that we each should be doing what we can right now. Saito and I will continue investigating this matter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let us know if you two ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can take care of coming up with ideas and writing scripts while you two investigate!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we start discussing our new offer...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Based on their proposal, we'll have a bit of time to talk about whatever we want, so we should use that chance to leave our mark!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Good work with today's meeting, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You too.
And thank you again for attending as well this time. Unfortunately, the others couldn't make it, so you were a big help...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That's okay. Times like these are what a manager is there for! Don't be afraid to ask me for anything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're on our side.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
With regards to that little dry spell of offers, did you learn anything on your end...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No... I tried asking people around the industry, but none of them were able to help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I even tried asking some of the staff we've worked with in the past between our meetings, but...)

rows.Speaker: Magazine Editor
rows.Line:
Huh? Rumors about MORE MORE JUMP!...?
H-Hmm... I can't say I have...

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Well... Each show does have a lot going on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No one seems to know...)

rows.Speaker: Magazine Editor
rows.Line:
O-Oh, look at the time!
I have to get to a meeting!

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Uhh... I need to help out over at my next set! Sorry, Haruka. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They were behaving a little oddly...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're going to meet with the others to do a stream after this, yes? I'll be stopping by the store to pick up a few things, so please go on ahead without me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Then, I'll see you in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, I'll see you again soon!
se_walk_women_001_1
A few hours later
MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, we'll have to wrap up today's stream here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for watching our “Full Body Workout ☆ Dance Lesson”, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We tried turning the moves to a well-known idol song into a workout track. What did you all think?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was tough, but it was also fun working out to a song I know!>
<I'm gonna be able to dance like Airi now...!>
<This song sounds so familiar. Where have I heard it before...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This song was used for a snack commercial back in the day. We decided to choose it because of its catchy beat and how popular it was back then!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I remember trying to copy the dance from this commercial when I was in elementary school! I really enjoyed our workout because it felt like such a huge blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that'd certainly explain why you didn't miss a single beat.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you nailed every move.>
<Oh, that commercial! Thank goodness you told us.>
<Speaking of commercials, I saw yours, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Some people are saying that they saw your commercial, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really?
It's wonderful to hear that so many people have seen it now.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <But... MORE MORE JUMP! isn't on TV as much anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, does this mean no more variety shows?>
<TV sorta hasn't felt the same lately without you girls.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... It's not always easy to make regular appearances since you need to know the right people and have a fair bit of luck.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We promise to let you all know if we do have anything planned, so stay tuned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also plan to spend more time on these streams to make up for less TV appearances.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, we hope you'll all be looking forward to our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, showbiz can be pretty tough...>
<It's cool that you'll be doing more streams.>
<I'm gonna watch your next one in real time too!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, as much as we hate to do this, it's time to say farewell.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for all the comments, you guys!
Make sure to stretch so that you don't feel sore tomorrow, okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was a great workout, but I am a little scared about tomorrow.>
<My upper arms are already pretty sore...>
<The cost of exercising...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was a pretty intense workout, so please make sure to cool down properly, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks again for watching today.
See you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some of our viewers have clearly noticed that we haven't been making as many appearances.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... We've started receiving offers again, but not nearly as many as before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is probably gonna worry them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If there's a reason behind all this, then we need to find out the truth.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we've already talked to just about everyone who we thought could tell us something.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The only person left is...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know I shouldn't ask him...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we don't have the luxury of keeping up appearances right now.)
Hotel Cafe

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I haven't talked to Mr. Hiiragi since Idol Lovers...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm a little nervous about asking him for advice since he's the producer of our rival group...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I have to try every lead that I can right now...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi's Voice
rows.Line: Kiritani.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been a while, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I apologize for making you wait.
My previous engagement took longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one apologizing for asking you to meet on such short notice. I know you're very busy, so thank you for making the time to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The last time we spoke was at Idol Lovers, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Thank you for collaborating with my group that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, our group should be thanking you.
We learned so much by watching ReLight.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They were the reason why we were able to perform at a higher level than normal that day.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I see...
Yes, your group did put on a remarkable performance that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm really glad you're saying that, Mr. Hiiragi.
But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something strange has happened since Idol Lovers... I'm here to talk to you about that today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, for a time after that event, we stopped receiving offers for work altogether...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've slowly begun receiving offers again recently, but it's nothing compared to what we were getting before Idol Lovers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, we understand that it might've simply been an unlucky period for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But... It happened so suddenly.
We think there must have been a reason, and we're trying to figure that out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know this is our group's problem.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I thought you would know something, Mr. Hiiragi, since you have your finger on the pulse of the industry. That's why I asked you to meet with me today.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, so... If you do happen to know of any rumors surrounding us, then would you mind telling me?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I can't say I have heard anything.
I'm not sure I can help you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What if there's no root cause? We might be on a wild goose chase here...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But based on what the other people who I've talked to have said—)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Doesn't your group employ staff?
Don't you have anyone to take care of these things?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: It just seems strange that a member of your group would take it upon herself to go out and investigate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, we do have a manager.
For the most part, she takes care of all the scheduling and such.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: So, you don't have someone running the show behind the scenes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We generally come up with ideas for streams and plans for our appearances as a group.
That being said...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been asked to be the producer for our group.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: You?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
I know I'm an amateur compared to you, Mr. Hiiragi...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see. That's certainly a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. I was also surprised.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Especially since I once gave up on being an idol altogether when I was a member of ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I later decided that I wanted to keep spreading hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That happened when I met the other members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I plan on doing everything I can for my group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I want to lead us down the right path.
Just like you did with ASRUN, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
But again, I'm sorry. I don't think I can help you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Thank you for taking the time to talk with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If Mr. Hiiragi doesn't know anything, then I guess that means Airi was right. We may've just been on a lucky streak before now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but...
Can I ask you one thing before you go?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If a group you were responsible for found itself in a situation like MORE MORE JUMP! is in now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If they weren't receiving any offers for unknown reasons, and you weren't certain whether things would ever go back to normal...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What would you do, Mr. Hiiragi?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Regardless of the situation, I wouldn't act differently.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I'd stick to my principles and keep moving forward. I'd continue to believe that they'd eventually break out of that situation.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Above all else, I would never lose sight of my goals.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to ramble on.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
But I need to get going.
If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course...
Thank you again for taking time out of your busy schedule to meet with me today.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Never lose sight of your goals”...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I remember being told the same thing when I was still in ASRUN.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (When you're trying to achieve something, those around you will say what they want. You might even get hung up on their words from time to time. But...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You can never lose sight of your goals.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi hasn't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(And he's right...
We need to keep our eyes on the prize.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means we have to do what we can right now.)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you talked to Mr. Hiiragi...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I asked him if he knew anything about us not receiving any offers... And, during our conversation, I remembered something really important.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That we can't lose sight of our goal of spreading hope to others, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The fact of the matter is that we're not getting as many offers as before... But all we have to do is get back to that point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And as the producer of MORE MORE JUMP!, I'm going to think of a way for us to do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I want the rest of you to keep thinking about spreading hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless of what sort of situation we're in, we can never lose sight of who we are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Haruka's right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not good for us to dwell on our problems. Our goal is to spread hope to as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm gonna try even harder in today's meeting for that show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since it's the first one where we get to appear as regulars!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All we did last time was introduce ourselves to everyone, but we get to hear more about it from the director today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Nakano was great to work with previously on “The Town Revitalization Team!”, and it's so nice that he's taking our input into account while developing this show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means we need to do our best and not let him down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of Mr. Nakano...
Didn't he also mention something about his next show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm... He's gonna be working on another new show next year, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and he said how he'd love to have us on board for that as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I know nothing has been decided yet...
But it might be worth asking him about that when we meet him today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In order to make that opportunity a reality and keep spreading hope to our viewers, we first need to do well during today's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
A few hours later
TV Station - Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we end today's meeting here?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Sounds good. I think we've given a thorough rundown of what this show's about...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Next time, we'll talk more in detail about the segment you'll be leading.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really starting to come together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so excited!
We really get to run a segment where we help people who write to us about their problems...!

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're feeling so optimistic about it.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: The truth is, I had MORE MORE JUMP! in mind for this segment ever since I started working on this show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really...?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Really. When we shot “The Town Revitalization Team!”, you and the locals had such organic interactions... We got a lot of good footage as a result.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: My hope is that this segment will give our viewers another taste of that down-to-earth atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll once again show us your authentic selves when we begin shooting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! You can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line:
Slow down, Mr. Nakano.
We're not scheduled to actually shoot for ages. We still need to hammer out all the details first.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line:
Haha. Very true. I'm just so excited...
But...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: I do genuinely believe that MORE MORE JUMP! will help turn this show into an instant classic. So, once again, I'm very much looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we're looking forward to working with you again as well!

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line: Then, if no one has anything else to add, let's call things here, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I do have one question.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About that other show you mentioned when we last met... Has there been any progress?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: When we last met?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you mentioned that you'd be working on a new show next year and how you were interested in having us on board...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: O-Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Umm... Unfortunately, a few things happened with that show since we last spoke...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: And I'm sad to say that due to various reasons, we've gone back to the drawing board regarding who'll be appearing on it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? Back to the drawing board?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you tell us those reasons...?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm not able to disclose that information...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, of course. Pardon me for asking...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry since I indicated that you'd be appearing in it. I feel so awful about what's happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We understand...
As unfortunate as this is, we know that there's a lot going on behind the scenes. Regardless, we're still looking forward to working with you on another project.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: So am I.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's clear the room.
We shouldn't overstay our welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They've gone back to the drawing board at this stage?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know it was still very preliminary, but Mr. Nakano seemed really excited about having us on...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Something isn't right here.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (While I'm already here at the station, I think I'll try talking to some of the staff I've worked with in the past.)
Several dozen minutes later
TV Station - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I understand.
And thank you for answering my questions. I know this was really sudden.

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry for not being able to help.
Anyway, Ms. Kiritani, I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you. I look forward to working with you again if we get that chance.
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm still grasping at straws...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I considered the possibility that we made some faux pas that everyone's too embarrassed to talk about... But, that's not the impression I've been getting.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But there's no use trying to think about this here. I need to refocus my attention.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Minori and the others have already gone.
I should head back to the MORE MORE HOUSE and—)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member
rows.Line: Oh, Mr. Nakano! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Ah, hello.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, it's Mr. Nakano...
He might've just gotten out of this other meeting. Before I leave, I should say goodbye and...)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: I heard the news about your new show for next year!

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: ReLight is going to appear on it as regulars, right?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(His new show for next year?
But he just said they'd gone back to the drawing board...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, did I just hear... ReLight...?)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: I was honestly really surprised since I know you're a huge fan of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: I told them earlier that we're starting from scratch when it comes to who'll be appearing.

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line:
I made a huge mistake.
It's all my fault for jumping ahead and saying that they were basically a lock for it...

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: I just ended up completely dashing their hopes.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
You know how things change really fast in this industry...

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: Also, there's nothing we can do when Mr. Hiiragi pushes so hard for his group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi...?
TV Station - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
Mr. Hiiragi pushed for this to happen...?)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: But I understand completely why you decided to go with ReLight, Mr. Nakano!

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We all made a decision together.
To keep trying regardless of the situation.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Would you mind if I asked you a question?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line:
Your current situation seems dire...
And yet, your eyes are twinkling with excitement.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: It's as if you're in the spotlight on stage right this second.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: What's allowing you to maintain such high spirits...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Allowing me to stay in high spirits...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's probably...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My determination to keep being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
As an idol...
I made up my mind to spread hope to as many people as I can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means I'm not allowed to lose sight of hope.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because I won't be able to spread hope if I don't keep any for myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still have so much to learn, and I'm embarrassed by the way little things can affect me so much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that determination is what keeps me going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Umm... I don't know if that answers your question...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm impressed by your resolve.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: You just showed me that I made the right choice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: I'm actually here today to discuss something with all four of you. So...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Would it be possible for you to call the others over right now?
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: I'm sorry for suddenly interrupting your practice like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, that's not a problem...!
But you wished to speak with us about something?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to be so formal with me. Today, I come with a proposal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A proposal?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line:
Yes.
I was hoping that I could help with your dream.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: I've been keeping a close eye on your group's activities since you moved in here.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: You've all been doing everything you can in the name of spreading hope to the masses...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Even in the face of insurmountable odds, you're all still working towards that goal.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: You confirmed for me that MORE MORE JUMP!'s members are people who can make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (People who can make their dreams come true. Does that mean...?)

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: I realized after talking to Minori that you all just might have what it takes to make your dreams come true. In other words, you're the ideal tenants for this place.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to support you all in making your dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Support us...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
Wh-What exactly do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Hehe. Exactly what you think it means.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: I want you all to become idols with the ability to spread more hope than anybody else. So...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Would you consider entering into something like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is this...an invitation?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, it's for MORE MORE JUMP!
And it's from...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The Lumina Grand Prix...?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: It's an invitation to appear in a certain idol program.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: A program that decides who the best idols in the country are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The best in the country...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: B-But... Where did you get this, Ms. Arisawa?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh...
She's told us that she likes to go see TV shoots... So, could that be why?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But this invitation's specifically for us...
Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (No way...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can't shake this feeling that I've seen her before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's been bugging me the whole time...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I knew I'd seen her before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I had no idea why until now. But this must mean she's...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hinako Arisawa...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, did you already know who I was...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I realized who you are just now...
But I've been wondering why you seem so familiar ever since we first met...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What in the world is going on here, Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hinako Arisawa.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The legendary idol who once had all of Japan eating out of her hand. Even now, she's still considered one of the greatest ever.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, but didn't she...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. Decades ago, at the peak of her popularity, she retired completely out of the blue. They say it was like she vanished into thin air...

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: I decided to step out of the limelight as an idol. The reason was because I wanted my fans to remember me as I was at my best.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Nowadays, I support idols from behind the scenes by passing on time-tested techniques and helping land offers for work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, this invitation is...?

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: Yes, it's my gift to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Landlady
rows.Line: As the organizer of this program, the Lumina Grand Prix.
